site.description: Walkable exhibitions for artists — hang work at museum scale, publish one link, and let collectors enter a real room on any device.

landing.headline: A room you enter. A show that stays.
landing.heroBody: Hang at museum scale. Publish one link. Collectors enter a quiet room — not a feed.
landing.walkBody: Pro hall, coastal pavilion, or a quiet white room — same first-person walk your visitors will take.
landing.servicesBody: Build walkable rooms, hang at museum scale, preview work in real spaces, and share a single opening — in English or Arabic.
landing.featureWalkableBody: Compose rooms visitors enter in first person — walls, light, and scale that feel like a real hang, not a scroll.
landing.featureHangBody: Place works on hang zones, drag to refine, edit frames, and tune lighting until the wall reads as a finished show.
landing.featureMockupsBody: See a painting on living-room, salon, and atelier walls — so collectors imagine the work where it will live.
landing.featurePublishBody: Open the show with one link, a QR code, or a catalogue view — phone and desktop, same quiet walk.
landing.featureHallsBody: From intimate white rooms to premium multi-wing halls — architecture with hang zones, not empty shells.
landing.featureLocaleBody: A bilingual interface for artists and visitors — direction, copy, and flow that respect both languages.
landing.featurePlansBody: Start free. Move to Pro or Studio when you need more walls, Pro halls, team seats, or storage.
landing.featureProfilesBody: Present yourself beside the work — bio, links, and socials so collectors can find and follow you.
landing.servicesPlansNote: Compare Free, Pro, and Studio when you are ready to grow the hang.
landing.templatesTitle: Rooms with walls worth hanging on
landing.templatesBody: Choose a hall. Place works on hang zones. Frames and light follow the architecture.
landing.collectorsTitle: See the work in the room it belongs to
landing.collectorsBody: Walk the exhibition. Enlarge a painting. Preview it on living-room and salon walls — then enquire.
landing.stepsTitle: From empty wall to open night
landing.stepsBody: Three steps. No plugins. No 3D software.
landing.step1Body: Upload paintings and place them on hang zones with gallery frames and light.
landing.step2Body: Preview the room in first person — titles, hotspots, and soft spotlights included.
landing.step3Body: Share one link. Visitors walk the show on phone or desktop.
landing.ctaTitle: Your next opening is a link
landing.ctaBody: Start free, or walk a filled Pro hall first.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more walls, Pro templates, team seats, or storage.
pricing.proBlurb: More rooms, Pro templates, deeper analytics.
pricing.studioBlurb: Serious volume for working artists and small teams.
pricing.footer: All plans include walkable publishing, first-person preview, and private originals. Upgrade or cancel anytime from Billing.

demo.title: Try before you sign in
demo.subtitle: Walk a filled hall, hang-scale mockups, or the free Modern White room — same viewer as published shows.
demo.proBody: Flagship Pro hall with twin wings, benches, and large hung works.
demo.harborBody: Bright coastal free hall — pale stone, morning window, long light wall.
demo.maisonBody: Haute viewing room — ivory plaster, brass light, polished limestone.
demo.walkBody: Modern White — nine large paintings, first-person controls.
demo.mockupsBody: See a painting on living-room, office, salon, gallery, and restaurant walls.
demo.ismailBody: The Hall — Roads, Figures, Marakeb, and Bait Al Shamsi Tree in the Pro Mega Wing.
demo.boatsBody: The Marakeb series in Noir Salon (Pro) — hulls, night voyages, charcoal studies.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Walkable rooms with materials, light, and hang zones sized for large paintings — not empty shells.
templates.livePreviewBody: Live preview of materials and hang scale. Select another room from the catalogue — only one canvas stays mounted.
